polaris: LP29-C2T / provenance-complete external joined table construction

framework.name: database normalization plus provenance semiring
framework.non_A_path: Treat C2T not as a literature extraction task but as a lossless-join certification problem: every row is valid only if the join key is a declared same-sample identity and every required attribute carries a nonzero provenance token.
framework.translation: A candidate joined row is a tuple r over required_join_fields. It is material-validation admissible only if pi_required(r) is complete, the join dependency among baseline, controls, graph features, and external labels is lossless on sample_id, and provenance multiplication across all required fields is nonzero.

math_object.object: lossless join dependency with provenance semiring annotation
math_object.admissibility_rule: material_validation_allowed(r) = true only if every required field is present, every provenance token p_f != 0, and the join R_identity join R_baseline join R_controls join R_graph join R_label is lossless on same-sample sample_id.
math_object.blocked_null: If any required field has provenance token 0 or the sample_id is a family/material proxy rather than same-sample key, the tuple remains a blocked provenance row, not a material validation row.

findings.core: Current C2T artifacts define a schema and blockers but do not contain any provenance-complete same-sample joined row.
findings.schema_landing: C2T_joined_table_schema.csv marks all required fields as material_validation_allowed=false; several are only defined or partial, and graph features are missing.
findings.blocker_landing: C2T_field_blocker_table.csv blocks sample_id, label_provenance_id, structure_or_SI_source, all G1 graph fields, and forbidden_control_audit, which prevents a lossless same-sample join.
findings.inventory_landing: C2T_source_inventory.csv classifies available sources as baseline_context_only, candidate_source_only, seed_context_only, blocked_table_only, audit_template_only, or external_label_candidate_only; none is a joined validation table.

strangest_prediction.prediction: A table can look empirically rich while still having zero admissible rows: adding more candidate labels or baseline rows will not increase validation capacity until the sample_id crosswalk and graph provenance are repaired.
strangest_prediction.test: Run a row-level audit that computes an admissibility bit per row using required fields. Under the current artifacts, every candidate row must evaluate to material_validation_allowed=false.
strangest_prediction.observable: The first unblock event should appear as a discontinuous change from 0 to at least 1 admissible row only when structure_id/sample_id, exact overlap normalization, G1 graph computation, and label provenance are co-present for the same specimen.

a_objection: A may argue that partial baseline rows plus candidate transport/spectral sources are enough to construct preliminary same-material rows. The database-frame objection is that same-material or same-family joins are lossy joins: they create tuples whose provenance polynomial contains a zero or proxy join factor, so they cannot certify material validation.

failed_jumps.reason: Useful language for chain-of-custody, but weaker than database lossless join because it does not directly express cross-sample tuple fabrication.
Erasure framing captures missing fields, but it incorrectly suggests recoverability from redundancy; here missing provenance is not statistically imputable.

next_plan.round2_direction: Build a row-level audit template with explicit boolean columns: has_same_sample_id, has_label_provenance, has_structure_source, has_exact_overlap_or_executable_formula, has_B0_controls, has_G1_graph_features, has_forbidden_control_audit, and material_validation_allowed.
minimum_unblock_sequence: Lock sample_id semantics as same specimen/snapshot/window, not material family.
Attach DOI/table/figure/SI row provenance to each external label.
Acquire auditable raw structure or SI source with stable structure_id.
Compute G1 features from locked graph construction on that structure.
Attach exact Srivastava-style overlap baseline or executable normalization for the same row.
Run forbidden-control audit after complete rows exist.

literature_needed: Srivastava 2019 exact orbital overlap normalization and SI/source structures
AOS or a-In2O3 datasets with same-sample raw structures plus Hall/Drude/Wannier/spectral labels
Jankousky 2025 supplementary material for row-level spectral/transport labels and structure crosswalk
Furubayashi transport source tables with sample identifiers, measurement conditions, and structure or synthesis batch mapping

claims.statement: Under a lossless-join interpretation, the current C2T artifacts contain zero material-validation-admissible rows because no row links baseline, controls, graph features, and external label through a same-sample sample_id.
assumptions: All listed required_join_fields are mandatory for material validation.
sample_id must mean same specimen/snapshot/window, not family-level material identity.
material_validation_allowed=false in schema/blocker artifacts is authoritative for this round.

claims.statement: Graph-feature provenance is the present hard bottleneck: all three G1 required fields are missing because no auditable raw material structure graph has been computed under a locked graph rule.
assumptions: Synthetic graph rows cannot substitute for material graph provenance.
A G1 value is admissible only when computed from an auditable atomistic graph with locked construction rules.

claims.statement: Partial fields such as O_s_or_exact_overlap_baseline, B0_carrier_density, B0_finite_size, B0_batch_or_family, external labels, and forbidden_control_audit do not compose into an admissible row because provenance multiplication is annihilated by missing same-sample crosswalk and no-rows-to-audit blockers.
assumptions: A partial field may support extraction planning but cannot support material validation.
Forbidden-control audit requires a candidate complete row; rules alone are not an audit result.

blockers.description: No same-sample key currently joins baseline, controls, graph features, and labels.
blockers.unblock_condition: Create stable row ids after structure-label-baseline crosswalk exists.

blockers.description: All material G1 graph features are missing because raw structures and locked graph computation are unavailable.
blockers.unblock_condition: Compute G1 metrics from auditable structures with fixed adjacency, weight, and damage rules.

blockers.description: Srivastava-style overlap baseline is partial but lacks exact executable normalization and same-structure mapping.
blockers.unblock_condition: Obtain SI/exact formula and map overlap values to the same structure rows used for graph computation.

blockers.description: Forbidden-control rules exist, but no complete row exists on which to run the audit.
blockers.unblock_condition: Run forbidden-control audit after a complete candidate row is assembled.
